Synopsis:
    Reuters human-interest report from Kyiv maternity Hospital No. 2 documenting women giving birth during active air raid alerts. Russia has significantly escalated its drone campaign since Aug 27, shifting to around-the-clock attacks targeting energy infrastructure. Officials warn conditions will worsen heading into winter. The piece also highlights Ukraine's deepening demographic crisis, with birth rates collapsing due to war, military conscription concerns, and economic pressures.
